scope: Product acceptance before the immutable archive and external publication; those later steps are recorded separately in the workspace delivery receipt.

verification.browserSummary: Actual isolated Chrome: both full configuration comparisons, own-source citations, filtering, keyboard focus, 390px English/Chinese, original-source navigation, portable practice/experiments/transfer, real downloads and refresh. In-app browser: real local AI, source jump, saved-answer refresh and export event; actual narrow answer layout.
verification.controlledUiSummary: Earlier mocked API acceptance checked support/refusal/unverified/legacy rendering and cancellation. These checks are distinct from the real local model runs.
verification.localAiSummary: Final r8: three real original-course answers, exact citations and preserved SQLite history; controlled cold/warm requests plus one actual UI request. r8 long-input/overflow checks are retained. The earlier r7 import/cloze/cancel fixture is separately labelled.
verification.offlineSummary: Both app and Ollama were run under a localhost-only process policy; external hostname and literal-IP curl probes failed. Real answers succeeded. Model-unavailable errors and recovery were observed. Whole-computer networking was unchanged.
verification.packageSummary: Fresh locked npm ci, final source/build equality, actual Mac launcher and served assets passed in an isolated installation. The package guard passed 16 synthetic checks. Final archive and anonymous downloads are checked separately after packaging.
